mentions.name: Outcrop
mentions.description: A knowledge base for software teams built from the ground up for speed, with reliable search and realtime collaboration, positioned as a complement to Linear for product management instead of Notion or Confluence.
mentions.problem: Teams that use Linear for product management still have to use Notion and Confluence for knowledge management.
mentions.audience: Software teams, with hundreds of teams from startups and major companies signed up for early access
mentions.source_excerpt: The fastest knowledge base for software teams, Outcrop.

evidence.value: The fastest knowledge base for software teams, Outcrop.

mentions.name: Outcrop
mentions.description: Outcrop is a Linear-inspired wiki and knowledge base for teams, built on custom search, collaboration, and authorization engines. Everything, including comments, is indexed, with instant search and navigation. The author is running private previews to collect feedback.
mentions.problem: Current knowledge base tools are too slow and too messy, and many companies end up developing custom internal wikis to supplement their Confluence one.
mentions.audience: Companies whose current knowledge base tools are too slow and messy, with many resorting to custom internal wikis to supplement Confluence.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Linear-inspired wiki:

https://outcrop.app

I've been working on Outcrop full-time for a few months now, since I left my job at Stripe. I think knowledge base systems are some of the most important components for successful companies. Current tools are too slow and too messy.
